name: Strand Perpetual
flavor: He stands up. The chassis is a great deal larger than a man and it moves exactly like one.

scanHints.text: Callum Strand, in the fourth chair, in the chassis he has been in since 2091.
One target. It has a second bar.
Break the chassis and what is inside is a person, and Signal will stop working.
Strand: I know exactly what he is going to try, because I would try it.
